description: Deb Haaland, the Democratic nominee for Governor of New Mexico, rallied voters from across the political spectrum in Las Cruces, with former Secretary of Transportation Pete Buttigieg, Congressman Gabe Vasquez, candidate for New Mexico’s second congressional district, and Vanessa Ordoñez, the Democratic nominee for Doña Ana County sheriff.
title: Haaland, Buttigieg, New Mexico Democrats Rally Voters In Las Cruces | Deb Haaland for New Mexico
